digest.component_or_area: root modules and services (src/rebar, attest, metrics, review_bot, opcert_service, audit, grounding)
propositions: Comment documentation in root-level modules (_mcp_models.py, _config_schema.py, _mcp_llm.py, review_bot/) contained stale and load-bearing assertions requiring relocation, correction, or preservation.

Schema assurance comments in _mcp_models.py claiming false test coverage are now accurate (BridgeFsckOut.binding_drift exists, CI drift gate python -m rebar.schemas.check_mcp_models --check is real, test_mcp_model_schema_drift_* tests exist).
_config_schema.py contains ~280 comment lines that are the sole documentation for keys absent from docs/config.md; recovering comment lines requires writing docs first to avoid losing documentation.
review_bot shutdown, in-flight counter, and retryable-deferral rationale blocks were relocated from inline comments to three new ADRs (0067/0068/0069) and replaced with one-line citations.

All in-scope non-KEEP comment units were dispositioned into RELOCATE, DELETE, KEEP, DO_NOT_MOVE, or CORRECT-IN-PLACE per parent-373f rules; no load-bearing invariant was lost; full test suite and lint pass unchanged.
